name: sift elements through a stabiliser chain, adding whatever does not sift to the identity
mechanism: fix a sequence of points; at each level keep one representative for every place the level's point can be sent; to sift an element, at each level compose with the inverse of the representative that undoes its action on that point; an element that sifts to the identity is already generated, otherwise its residue is added as a new generator and the affected levels are re-closed

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Schreier–Sims algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Abstract algebra: computing a base and strong generating set (BSGS) of a permutation group

fails_when: a poor base makes the chain long
